source_path_base: Paths in source fields are relative to the voice-agent repository root. ../docs is external evaluation evidence and is not bundled with this template.
definition_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of json.dumps(definition, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True). This is a semantic JSON fingerprint, not the raw file SHA256.

provenance.source_form: Portable authored {name, description, definition} document; exact source bytes, not expanded node prompts from a materialized deployment definition.
provenance.source_hash_verified_against: scope_proof.json /source_sha256 and both plans /candidate_source_sha256; materialized file bytes also match both plans /candidate_definition_file_sha256.
provenance.binding_policy: The source already has only empty server_url and project_connection_id placeholders. They are retained byte-for-byte; the publisher supplies deployment bindings. No Project, test Agent name, URL, or credential was copied from the materialized evidence.

candidate_status.selection_reason: Freeze the latest stable authored candidate-04 while its evaluation is in progress. Candidate-03 is the latest completed captured/reviewed candidate at the observation time and remains rejected; its results are not candidate-04 results.
candidate_status.ledger_note: The source and definition are hash-pinned snapshots. Active external ledgers may change after this observation; the recorded statuses and hashes are not a claim about later evaluation progress.
previous_candidate_failures_not_proven_f: Candidate-03 omitted required pre-tool feedback in a formal report conversation and used awkward category labels in a functional conversation.
